朝鮮防疫統計 1938

Chōsen bōeki tōkei (Epidemic Prevention Statistics of Korea), 昭和十三年 (Shōwa 13), published 1939
朝鮮總督府警務局, 京城, 1939 (昭和十四年十月十五日發行)

All 76 tables are transcribed; the 凡例 and the contents are not. Each table is printed across both pages of a spread and is given here as one table, including those that run over several spreads. As in the 1939 edition, many printed totals do not add up: they are kept as printed and noted in each table, as are printed heading and label errors (for example 全鮮北道 for 全羅北道 in table 30, and table 52 headed 道別 where the contents has 病別). Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Province names and a few characters are given in the old forms the book uses (忠淸, 慶尙, 黃, 齡, 檢査). 30 of about 77,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?].
